[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/build-step-1 step.action: PVC from volumeClaimTemplates; placeholder container (nothing persists between runs and the paths are not copied; the action is applied without a step; a container that runs true keeps its place)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/build/step/build-step-2 step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)

[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/test/step/test-step-2 step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
